description:
## Goal

Prove, via end-to-end automated verification, that sandboxing satisfies the locked auditability contract on the spawn surfaces that gate the default rollout.

## Locked contract reference

See `scenarios/swarm-manager/research/agent-sandbox-auditability-contract/conclusion.md` Finding 5 (validation matrix) and Finding 6 (rollout sequencing).

## Surface scope

This item must demonstrate the validation matrix on the **agent-manager UI** and **swarm-manager queue** spawn surfaces. The cron and direct-CLI spawn surfaces flip in follow-on items and are explicitly OUT OF SCOPE for this verification gate.

## Validation matrix (must all pass)

1. Every sandboxed agent-manager run produces a provenance record correlating sandbox -> run -> conversation -> cost. Eager creation means even no-op runs leave an empty provenance entry.
2. Failed runs that produced changes still write provenance and still auto-apply (subject to acceptance), with `runOutcome` captured on the provenance record.
3. Restart and test flows operate against the merged sandbox path when `VROOLI_SANDBOX_*` env vars are present, and against the canonical repo otherwise.
4. `acceptanceDeny` violations never reach the canonical repo, even with `autoApply=true`.
5. Out-of-`acceptanceAllow` changes are retained as `state=pending-review` provenance and visible in GCT's AI Changes review queue (and in the agent-manager and workspace-sandbox diff views).
6. GCT auto-links a commit to a pending provenance record when their changed-file sets overlap.
7. Multiple concurrent sandboxes over the same scope coexist without lock errors (per `lock=false` default), and acceptance still gates each independently.
8. `vrooli scenario heal-from-sandbox` (Go-based, in `internal/scenario`) restarts any scenarios still running from the merged path on sandbox teardown.
9. `manualReview=true` defers apply until operator approval; the sandbox persists across run end; approving from any of the three surfaces (GCT, agent-manager, workspace-sandbox) produces the same applied state and records the originating surface on the state transition.

## Expected deliverables

1. Integration / scenario-level tests covering the nine behaviors above on agent-manager UI and swarm-manager queue spawn surfaces.
2. Focused regression tests around cli-core sandbox path resolution (`packages/cli-core/cliutil/sandbox.go`) and the Go-based scenario-restart code (`internal/scenario`, `internal/scenarioexec`, `internal/cli/vroolicli`, `internal/repocontractcheck`).
3. Documentation of any gaps that cannot yet be covered automatically, plus the shortest path to cover them later.
4. A pass/fail readiness checklist that `execute/agent-manager-default-sandboxing-rollout` consumes verbatim.

## Key references

- `packages/cli-core/cliutil/sandbox.go`
- `packages/cli-core/cmd/sandbox-resolve/main.go`
- `internal/scenario/scenario.go`
- `internal/scenarioexec/subprocess.go`
- `internal/cli/vroolicli/runtime.go`
- `internal/repocontractcheck/checks.go`
- `scenarios/test-genie/cli/execute/command.go`
- `scenarios/agent-manager/api/internal/orchestration/run_executor.go`
- `scenarios/swarm-manager/research/agent-sandbox-auditability-contract/conclusion.md`
